blocks.text: The Toledo Xignex Trojans served their revenge on a silver platter, beating the Sudeco-Manila Indios Bravos, 11.5-9.5, in their rematch in the ongoing Philippine Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup on Saturday, October 31, with Russian Grandmaster (GM) Aleksey Sorokin leading the charge. ...
